en: Black-and-white photograph of a quiet European town street, likely from the late 19th or early 20th century. Two- to three-story masonry townhouses with stuccoed and ornamented facades line both sides. The roofs are steep and tiled; several buildings have gabled dormers and small turrets typical of Central European architecture. The street surface appears unpaved or only partially cobbled, with a raised stone sidewalk. A small group of people, including women and children in period clothing, sit and stand near the center-left of the street. The far end of the street closes with lower buildings and some trees. No modern vehicles or electric infrastructure are visible. There is faint signage above one ground-floor shop, but it is too indistinct to read clearly.
